bullets.text: Storm water drains in Taramani and Velachery have five feet of accumulated waste, causing severe flooding due to a metro work contractor.
A cyclone warning signal has been hoisted at nine ports across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, including Chennai and Ennore.
Fifteen employees at the wildlife division office in Velachery are working in fear as the building is in danger of collapsing due to a lack of renovation funds.
The Pallikaranai marsh has become a year-round home for spot-billed pelicans, with hundreds feeding and breeding in the area.
The meteorological department clarified that the radar near Chennai Fort was functioning after rumors spread that it had stopped working during the monsoon rains.
Avadi Corporation is left in darkness as streetlights fail to function despite a twenty two crore rupee contract, causing widespread public concern.
Minjur block development officer Vedanayagi inspected monsoon precautionary works and drainage in Nallur panchayat, where locals confronted officials.
Commuters welcomed the new AC suburban train services on the western section covering Tiruvallur and Arakkonam, while noting high fares and missing stations.
The Tamil Nadu government plans to launch twenty five modern sub-registrar model offices with private participation in Chennai, starting with an initial five centers.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India data center and cybersecurity training institute in Khordha district, emphasizing banking protection.
NCERT has introduced a twenty-hour introductory module on computational thinking and artificial intelligence for classes nine through twelve in consultation with experts.
DMK President M.K. Stalin criticized the ruling TVK government, pointing to rising prices, corruption, and worsening law and order while calling for a united opposition.
JCD Prabakar asked people to pray for Vijay, stating that he keeps nothing for himself and focuses on what he can give to the public.
